---
title: "Descriptions (knitr)"
filters:
  - panzoom
expect-errors: []
expect-descriptions:
  - "Say “hi”, then stop."
  - "Compare a, “hint”: true, and more."
  - "{“a”: 1, “b”: [2, 3]}"
  - "Braces } and ] and , “x”:"
  - 'It’s a “quoted” one, with \(\theta = \alpha_1\)'
  - 'Two lines, joined as one, with \(\nabla f \neq 0\).'
  - "First of two, with a “quote”, and a comma."
  - "Second of two."
---

Descriptions that look like more options, as knitr passes them: each must come
through whole.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Say "hi", then stop.'
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Compare a, "hint": true, and more.'
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: '{"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]}'
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Braces } and ] and , "x":'
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: "It's a \"quoted\" one, with $\\theta = \\alpha_1$"
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: |
#|     Two lines, joined
#|     as one, with $\nabla f \neq 0$.
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   group: pair
#|   description:
#|     - 'First of two, with a "quote", and a comma.'
#|     - Second of two.
#|   hint: false

plot(1)
plot(2)
plot(3)
```
